description:
backend.rs:625-646 — query_calendar_events returns Result<QueryResult, QueryCalendarEventsError<Self::Error>>, where QueryCalendarEventsError carries exactly the two draft-specified method-level error codes:

  ExpandDurationTooLarge → maps to expandDurationTooLarge (§10.7.3)
  CannotCalculateOccurrences → maps to cannotCalculateOccurrences (§10.7.4)
  Other(E) → maps to serverFail

A naive shape would be:
  fn query_calendar_events(...) -> Result<QueryResult, Self::Error>
…and force the backend to invent string-tagged errors. The typed enum:
1. Prevents backends from inventing nonconformant error codes for these two cases.
2. Keeps the handler's mapping (event.rs:883-892) a clean match arm rather than a string-prefix sniff.
3. Marked #[non_exhaustive] so future draft errors (e.g. 'expansionRateLimitExceeded') can be added without SemVer break.

The handler maps these to JmapError::custom('expandDurationTooLarge') — the spec error name. This is exactly the shape RFC 8620 says custom method errors must take (§3.6.1 'invalidArguments' enum + new method-specific codes).

DEFEND when reviewers suggest 'just use Self::Error with String tags'.
title: QueryCalendarEventsError enum keeps spec-required error codes typed
